Package com.kerosene.kfe.adapters.in.http.dto.wallet

Record Class KfeColdWalletPsbtRequest

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.kerosene.kfe.adapters.in.http.dto.wallet.KfeColdWalletPsbtRequest
Record Components:
destinationAddress - external Bitcoin address receiving the requested amount
amountSats - amount to send in satoshis; the validation minimum is the dust threshold
confirmationTarget - desired confirmation count used to select a fee rate
feeRateSatsPerVbyte - explicit fee-rate override, when provided
inputs - optional UTXOs the caller asks to include in the PSBT
totpCode - optional one-time password required by step-up policy
public record KfeColdWalletPsbtRequest(@NotBlank @Size(max=128) String destinationAddress, @jakarta.validation.constraints.Min(546L) long amountSats, @Min(1L) Integer confirmationTarget, @Min(1L) Long feeRateSatsPerVbyte, @Valid List<KfeColdWalletPsbtRequest.Input> inputs, String totpCode) extends Record
Validated request for constructing a PSBT that spends from a cold wallet.
